text: In fast-moving fields such as technology, law, and public policy, models trained on obsolete datasets fail to capture new trends, behaviors, or regulatory changes, which reduces their predictive and explanatory power.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Artificial Intelligence The Final Frontier (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5095633
abstract: In rapidly evolving fields—technology, law, or public policy—models trained on obsolete datasets fail to capture new trends, behaviors, or regulatory changes, ultimately reducing their predictive and explanatory power.
